params.caption: 🖥️ DRAM price-fixing lawsuit against Micron, Samsung and SK hynix moves ahead A US judge has denied the chipmakers' motion to dismiss, finding the collusion claims plausible after a memory price surge of around 500%. The judge described the three companies as "hawks flying in formation" in their business decisions. RAM prices have hit PC builders hard, so this case matters to gamers. 🕒 Nov 15, 2026 · 18:09 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Tom's Hardware 💸 React if RAM prices hurt your build · 💬 Do you think prices will drop? #DRAM #RAM #PCHardware #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
